name: Pineapple Haze Live Resin Gummies
description: Premium Live Resin Gummies are made using pure full-spectrum live resin extract, which allows consumers to experience all the benefits of the “Entourage Effect”. These gummies are designed for experienced consumers and feature strain-specific cannabis derived terpenes. This delicious pineapple flavor has an activation time of 1-2 hours and a potent 200mg THC per package.
